name: p3_thm1_not_dvd
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h5 : 5 < p) : ¬ p ∣ p3_fibsum p
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h5 : 5 < p), ¬ p ∣ p3_fibsum p
informal: for a prime p > 5, p does not divide S_p
original: In particular, $S_p$ is not divisible by $p$.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 5 < p → ¬p ∣ Mathlib2.p3_fibsum p
